text:
Lauren: @Priya customer BrightWave asked about onboarding Odin-15B for RAG. They need ~2k-token conv RAG, p99 target ~150ms, ~60 qps. Can we take this?
Priya: Can you paste the model artifact link + license? Also need an eval harness. :eyes:
Lauren: Link: s3://redwood-cust/brightwave/odin-15b/v1/model.tar.gz. License = research-with-commercial (requires contract). They prefer int8 quant if feasible.
Sanjay: Recommend trying q3/q4 int8 first, fallback to fp16 if quality regresses. Expect ~2-3x speedup but watch factuality and instruction-follow.
Matt: I'll run the bring-up perf suite on g5.12x and g5.48. Need eval tasks: summarization, instruction-follow, factuality.
Eva: I can assemble eval sets: summarization (100), instruction (200), factuality (FEVER subset 50). Will upload to eval bucket by EOD.
Priya: Adding to intake board, tagging priority=high — customer has dedicated capacity reserved. Also request privacy/security review for S3 access.
Lauren: Created ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-5601. @deploy-bot please kick the presubmitted model-test job.
deploy-bot: queued job model-test/odin-15b/1842103456 on runner-043. CI: https://ci.redwood/models/1842103456 :robot_face:
Matt: Quick paste of config I used for first perf run:
```
config:
  batch_size: 8
  seq_len: 2048
  quant: int8
  kv_cache: true
```
Matt: Initial results: p50 ~48ms on g5.48, p99 ~220ms with int8. Micro-batching + kernel tuning needed.
Sanjay: Try batching_policy: 'time' with max_wait_ms=12 and autoshrink_kv=true. Also test fused attention kernels (kernel_v2).
Priya: Suggested go/no-go checklist: 1) license & contract confirmed, 2) perf p99 <= 180ms on target HW, 3) eval delta within acceptable threshold (<1% per metric), 4) security/compliance signoff, 5) rollout policy (canary + fallback). Assign owners.
Lauren: I'll own customer comms. Matt owns perf runs. Priya owns compliance & rollout. Sanjay owns quant experiments. Eva owns evals. We'll reconvene with updates in ~24h. :thumbsup:
